summary: On July 31, 2026, Uniti Group Inc. announced via Form 8-K that its wholly owned subsidiaries amended their asset sale offers for 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and 7.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2033. The offers increased from $332,209,000 to $480,236,000 aggregate principal following a prepayment election of $19.8 million on its term loan due 2032 out of a $167,791,000 offer. Other terms unchanged. Sodali & Co. serves as information and tender agent. This issuer tender offer is a debt repurchase, not equity-related, so risk-arb focus is on note pricing and tender participation. Watch for final acceptance and proration levels.
